'''Koro Ferbin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]], who worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In c. [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ferbin was present in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when he was approached by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. The Padawan was trying to find out who was responsible for a recent attack on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and wanted to obtain this information from Ferbin. After seeing that the Padawan was carrying a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Ferbin happily divulged the information, revealing that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vogg Barakk]] was responsible for the attack, and that Barakk was hiding out in [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] district of Coruscant.
